description: This file defines locale-specific information for the 'en-JM' (English Jamaica) culture, including date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and date prototype extensions for manipulating date objects according to Jamaica locale conventions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a date object to zero, effectively removing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new date object representing the current date at midnight.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
